description:
Pages Functions routing rules — paths under `exclude` skip the 525-line _middleware.js entirely and serve straight from the edge (Pages static asset path), saving Worker invocations and CPU time on the Free-tier daily quota. `include` is the default catch-all; `exclude` wins when both match. Order doesn't matter — Cloudflare evaluates exclude first.

What must stay in `include`:
  - /api/*           — every API endpoint is a Function
  - /stocks/*        — middleware adds Cache-Tag + analytics tracking (purge-by-tag depends on this; do NOT exclude even though it would save more quota)
  - /clients/*       — same: Cache-Tag + analytics
  - /dashboard/*     — has its own _middleware.js
  - /dist/*          — has its own Functions handler
  - /{locale}/...    — middleware does i18n routing + canonical-URL redirects
  - /content/, /api-reference/, /sign-up/, /onboarding/ — locale-fallback routing in middleware

What is safe to `exclude` (no middleware side effects, just env.ASSETS.fetch passthrough):
  - /cdn/*/dist/*    — pre-built JS bundles (stratos, prism, etc.) — pure static
  - /cdn/shared/*    — language-agnostic CSS/JS/HTML (theme.css, branding/, site-nav.*)
  - /cdn/sitemap.xml, /cdn/robots.txt — search-engine metadata
  - /favicon.ico, /favicon.*.png — browser icon requests
  - /.well-known/*   — standardised public metadata (security.txt, change-password, etc.)
  - /coverage/*      — vitest coverage report (committed artifact, not user-facing)
